item.title: Bologna 2-2 Celtic – Mixed emotions, but a point well earned
item.description: Mixed emotions, but that’s a precious point well earned as Celtic edge towards play-off qualification… After a long, gruelling, nervy game, last night in Bologna, we can all be content with our efforts in earning a hard fought point. item.title: “I thought it was really innocuous,” Martin O’Neill on Reo Hatate’s Red Card
item.description: Celtic were forced to settle for a hard-earned point in Italy after finishing much of their clash with Bologna last night a man short, with post-match attention centring on Reo Hatate’s controversial dismissal… Martin O’Neill voiced his frustration over the decision that led to Hatate receiving a second yellow card, describing the incident as ‘innocuous.’ Read More

item.title: Celtic hero Auston Trusty praises “mentality of the team”
item.description: Auston Trusty praised Celtic’s resilience after the Hoops came through a demanding European test away to Bologna, insisting the performance highlighted the squad’s renewed spirit following a challenging period under Wilfried Nancy… “It shows the mentality of the team” Auston Trusty reflects on Celtic’s 2-2 draw with Bologna… 🎙️ @missconniemac 📺 @tntsports & @discoveryplusUK pic.twitter.com/IFqsVcPzqS Read More

item.title: Late Eighties Decline – Celtic v Borussia Dortmund, 1987
item.description: LATE EIGHTIES DECLINE- CELTIC v BORUSSIA DORTMUND, 1987… In 1987, after 23 seasons in European competitions, Celtic had NEVER been drawn against a team from West Germany.
